application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: This decision notice for Tree Works is only valid for 2 years from the date of this decision or until the work is completed, whichever is the sooner. Reason: In order to ensure that the work is carried out whilst still appropriate and in accordance with the time period within the legislation and regulations.

A replacement tree for Oak T1  shall be planted in accordance with the following specifications:Tree Species: Field Maple Quantity: x1 Size/Height: 14-16cm stem circumference at 1m, to be planted in accordance with the recommendations in British Standard 8545:  Trees from nursery to independence in the landscape - Recommendations (2014). Root ball or container grown is acceptable.Location: In the same position as the original tree, or in an alternative position to be agreed in writing by the Council.Deadline: Within 3 months  following the removal of the original tree, or an alternative date to be agreed in writing by the Council.The tree shall thereafter be maintained and shall not be pruned or removed without the written consent of the Council
